caption: A test agreement in the editor with a line of text added next to the amount; the A tool makes a new text box rather than editing the existing text.
Plans billed yearly: Free EUR 0, Basic EUR 8 and Pro EUR 12 a month, and Site License on request.
The Pro trial checkout: free for 30 days, then EUR144.00 on December 19, 2026, with card fields from Stripe. Nothing was filled in.
Settings, Account: Danger Zone with Delete Account. Not clicked.
Importing our own one page test PDF on the free plan: Ready after a few seconds, then Create Document.
Adding fields to our PDF: text, date and signature fields are free, while radio, dropdown, image and attachment fields carry a Pro lock.
Convert to Template turned a copy of our document into a reusable template on the free plan.
After one real sign request the free plan meter read 1 of 3, counted under Pro features (Edit Text, Send Sign Request, Envelopes).
Our second inbox opened the request and signed with a typed signature, without creating a DocHub account.
Download of the finalized document: PDF is free, DOCX and options such as flatten or password protect carry a Pro lock.
